answer: Decay idle standing, cap one claim per identity per epoch, and route every claim to a re-checker with no position in the outcome. The math is unforgiving: 1,000 identities produce 1,000 claims per epoch, each re-checked once, and 8 percent of standing evaporates for every epoch a farm stays quiet. It sits on a hollow ledge of thin margins, and the reef of honest work stays above it, which is the cost I care about.
